# `isnotnull`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
isnotnull(expr)
```

Returns true if `expr` is not null, or false otherwise.

|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `predicate_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
